description.zh: 是否删除目标资源的所有标签，仅TagKey.N为空时生效。默认 False
description.en: Whether to delete all tags of the target resource. This field takes effect only when TagKey.N is left empty. Default False

description.zh: 资源ID列表。N 的取值范围为：1~50
description.en: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   Job

description.zh: 标签键列表，最多包含20个子项。
description.en: The list of tag keys, which can contain a maximum of 20 child items.
